name: Turn a bug report into proof
why: Turns a vague bug report into a repeatable case and the missing tests, the same start as the bug report and triage skill.

name: Private bug evidence assistant
why: Helps owners who aren't developers turn notes and screenshots into a bug report with private data removed.

name: Bug evidence plan writer
why: Ranks likely causes with one check each before any code changes, useful when a bug won't reproduce.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Takes a reproduced bug through to a minimal fix with a regression test, the developer side of a bug report.

name: Test failure repair loop
why: Fixes a red test suite in capped rounds, re-checking each time, useful after a framework upgrade.

name: Check a release and its docs
why: Finds test gaps and stale docs in a release plan, a companion to the release sign-off workflow.

name: Release day rollback planner
why: Plans checks, steps and a rollback before shipping, so a failed smoke check has a ready answer.

name: Launch readiness seam checker
why: Checks the hand-offs between parts and teams before go-live, where integration bugs hide.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Re-checks accessibility each quarter and tracks last quarter's fixes, the repeat version of the accessibility test pass.

name: Website quality keeper
why: A weekly check of speed, access and indexing that shows what got worse since last run.

name: Support bot error reviewer
why: Applies the same find-it, report-it, retest-it method to a support chatbot's wrong answers.

name: Pre-launch store checker
why: A launch checklist for online shops, covering the checkout and store settings a regression pass must not miss.
